card.name: Adverbs and phrases in formal prose
card.fires_on: Adverbs or linking phrases in older, formal essay-style prose, such as "on the contrary", "chiefly", "scarcely", "more or less", and the "ang" in "Strangely/Strangest". It fires just before the sentence continues with a qualifying or contrasting idea.

modes.label: Qualifying adverbs
modes.description: Adverbs like chiefly, scarcely and less that modify the following verb or adjective in scholarly text.
modes.example: Salts of strontium are<< chiefly>> used in pyrotechny, impart

modes.label: Contrast phrases
modes.description: The word contrary or similar phrase words in "on the contrary" or "by virtue of".
modes.example: took nothing for granted; on the<< contrary>>, he employed every possible preca

modes.label: Strange sentence openers
modes.description: The middle piece of Strangely or Strangest at the start of a sentence.
